description: This file defines the class 'SavingsAccountHelper', which provides a comprehensive set of helper methods for managing and testing savings account operations within the Apache Fineract project. The methods include applying for, approving, activating, closing, deleting savings accounts, as well as performing transactions such as deposit, withdrawal, charges, interest posting, and account blocking/unblocking. It also contains utility functions for constructing JSON payloads and URLs related to savings account commands, often marked as deprecated with a note to migrate towards using the fineract-client library. The class is mainly used in integration tests and interacts with server APIs via REST calls, utilizing various utility classes for HTTP requests and JSON processing.
